title: Revised evolutionary relationships within Brachycera and the early origin of bicoid in flies
authors: Mulhair PO; Pennati A; Herrera-Ubeda C; Holland PW
one_liner_zh: 该文利用基因组数据研究双翅目系统发育及bicoid转录因子的演化起源，虽涉及转录因子但无蛋白-DNA互作建模或AI/物理模拟方法，与本课题核心无关。
abstract: The specification of the anterior-posterior axis in the embryo is a crucial step in early insect development. Despite its importance, the underlying genetic and regulatory architecture controlling this process varies significantly between species. In cyclorrhaphan flies, such as Drosophila melanogaster , anterior determination is controlled by the transcription factor bicoid , which emerged through duplication of the ancestral Hox3 gene (called zen in insects). With new, high-quality genomic data we mine the genomes of 186 dipteran species, and find presence of bicoid in non-cyclorrhaphan flies, including in the bee flies (family Bombyliidae) and the stiletto flies (Therevidae). We confirm maternal expression and localisation of the non-cyclorrhaphan bicoid mRNA to the anterior region of the unfertilised oocyte in the dark edged bee fly, Bombylius major . To determine the timing and origin of bicoid , we address uncertainty in the dipteran phylogeny, uncovering a ladder-like topology in the branching orders of the early Brachycera lineages. This new species phylogeny suggests that bicoid emerged at the common ancestor of Bombyliidae, Asiloidea, and Eremoneura (collectively Heterodactyla), and was subsequently lost at least 16 times. These findings expand our understanding of the early developmental processes in flies and provide new insights into the backbone phylogeny of Diptera and the evolution of bicoid .
abstract_zh: 胚胎中前-后轴的特化是昆虫早期发育中的关键步骤。尽管其重要性，控制这一过程的潜在遗传和调控结构在不同物种间差异显著。在环缝类蝇类中，如黑腹果蝇（*Drosophila melanogaster*），前部决定由转录因子bicoid控制，该因子通过祖先Hox3基因（在昆虫中称为zen）的复制而产生。利用新的高质量基因组数据，我们挖掘了186种双翅目物种的基因组，发现bicoid存在于非环缝类蝇类中，包括蜂虻科（Bombyliidae）和剑虻科（Therevidae）。我们确认了在暗缘蜂虻（*Bombylius major*）中，非环缝类bicoid mRNA的母源表达及其在未受精卵母细胞前部的定位。为确定bicoid的时间和起源，我们解决了双翅目系统发育中的不确定性，揭示了早期短角亚目（Brachycera）谱系分支顺序中的阶梯状拓扑结构。这一新的物种系统发育表明，bicoid在蜂虻科、虻总科（Asiloidea）和舞虻次目（Eremoneura）（统称为异距类Heterodactyla）的共同祖先中出现，并随后至少丢失了16次。这些发现扩展了我们对蝇类早期发育过程的理解，并为双翅目的主干系统发育及bicoid的进化提供了新见解。
